scope: Real HTTP and loopback SMTP with synthetic addresses; negative OAuth callbacks only, no live Google account or external email
checks: disabled providers stay unavailable; instance configuration is administrator-only
encrypted provider secrets are redacted and configuration saves use revision CAS
unsafe mail/origin settings and secret forwarding are rejected; saved SMTP actually delivers
sensitive configuration requires fresh authentication without extending session expiry
email is verified once by its initiating session and becomes a working login identifier
pending/expired email replacements preserve the prior verified email and resend is bounded
generic email recovery is single-use, changes the password and revokes every prior session
a mailed recovery link cannot overwrite a newer password
Google code flow carries state/nonce/PKCE; missing/wrong browser binding and replay cannot link
verified email, provider configuration and valid sessions survive a core restart
